regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad, non-directional rotation (56% eligible), with leadership in Base Metals & Copper and Oil & Gas Producers both eligible and uncrowded. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped on this market (gate_helps=true), so trend-gate discipline is the one leg worth honoring, but the detector's own track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.347 — direction calls have been barely better than a coin flip, so any lean must be low conviction and heavily conditional.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream (rank 6, score 0.015, trend hurst, unscorable) is the only eligible theme with a trend hurst tag outside the crowded Technology theme. Watching whether it climbs into rank 3 or better with breadth above 0.3 — that would retire the watch.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Highest momentum rank and current rotation leader with modest breadth (0.556) and uncrowded positioning. The trend-gate eligibility is the one validated leg; combined with the leader's durability bar (0.5) and mean-revert hurst tag (which makes trend persistence the explicit risk), a trim-then-hold lean is supportable only if price stays above its trend gate. Not a buy because the detector leads.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag and only 0.556 breadth suggest leadership is fragile; copper/base metals are the classic reflexivity fade candidate if the global macro narrative (geopolitics-heavy, 40% unscheduled surprise share) shifts sharply.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day average for 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Rank 2, eligible, and the rotation challenger with a larger durability bar (0.61) and better breadth (0.571) than the leader. The rotation margin is very thin (0.11), so this is not a handoff — just a co-leader. Trend-gate eligibility is the support; the mixed hurst tag adds uncertainty rather than edge.
theses.dissent: Absorption is low (0.3) and the rotation is explicitly non-directional, so simultaneous leadership with Base Metals is just a broad cyclical bid; if macro risk-off hits, energy gets sold with everything else.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags XBM.TO by more than 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Rank 8 but is the only crowded theme (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.16). The guardrails forbid fading on crowding, so this is not an underweight — just a note that crowding combined with a middling score means no new capital should chase this theme. This is a cap/discipline call, not a directional negative.
theses.dissent: The durability bar is high (0.63) and hurst is mixed, so a crowded theme with high durability could persist longer than a naive crowding read would suggest; avoiding too early is the risk.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX composite by 3% over the next 30 days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
